lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Bruna Defrain | Lesson 2 -- At the Gate

listenings.text: Good evening, passengers. This is an announcement for flight SA two four seven to London. The flight is delayed. The new time is ten o'clock. Boarding is at nine fifteen, at gate twelve. Gate twelve, not gate ten. Please have your passport in your hand. Thank you.

Hi, Bruna. This is Anna, from Sky Air. A short message about your flight to London. Your seat is fourteen A. It is a window seat, not an aisle seat. Boarding is at gate twelve, at nine fifteen. Have a good trip!

extra_audio.text: Bruna is at gate 12. She looks at the board. The flight is not on time. It is delayed. She asks: is 14A a window seat? Mark says: yes, it is.

lesson.grammar_point: verb to be in questions and negatives (Is it...? / it is not)
